scenes.title: Truth in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Javier explains how he accidentally swapped suitcases with Carmen on Monday's train and panicked at the gate.

scenes.title: Three Years of Silence
scenes.summary: At the front desk Mateo unlocks the blue suitcase for Javier, who explains the three-year silence with his brother Tomas.

scenes.title: Friday Lemon Cake
scenes.summary: Carmen recalls what the brothers always ate after Friday piano lessons, giving Rocio a bright baking idea.

scenes.title: Two Chairs Under the Tree
scenes.summary: Clara, Rocio, and Mateo arrange a quiet corner table under the courtyard tree and check the string of lanterns.

scenes.title: Simple Words First
scenes.summary: At eleven forty Javier practices stiff speeches in the courtyard until Clara helps him choose three simple, honest lines.

scenes.title: Ten Minutes to Twelve
scenes.summary: At eleven fifty the postman drops off an official registered letter for Ernesto, who sets it aside to greet noon.

scenes.title: Twelve Chimes
scenes.summary: Twelve o'clock strikes with an empty gate, Javier loses hope for a long minute, and then a taxi brakes outside.

scenes.title: The Red-Stamped Letter
scenes.summary: As Tomas steps into the courtyard outside, Ernesto opens the landlord's letter inside and turns pale at a sale notice.
